name: TextWrap
brief: Enumeration that defines methods used for wrapping text.
description: This enum provides options to control how text is wrapped when it exceeds the available space. Wrapping affects the layout and flow of text in the rendering area.

members.name: None
members.brief: Do not wrap text. Text is rendered on a single line and may overflow the bounding area.

members.name: Character
members.brief: Wrap at the character level. If a word cannot fit, it is broken into individual characters to fit the line.

members.name: Word
members.brief: Wrap at the word level. Words that do not fit are moved to the next line.

members.name: Smart
members.brief: Smart choose wrapping method: word wrap first, falling back to character wrap if a word does not fit.

members.name: Ellipsis
members.brief: Truncate overflowing text and append an ellipsis ("...") at the end. Typically used for single-line labels.
